question: Can one control decision safely fan out into many self-service worker tasks without manual assignment or scope collisions?
hypothesis: A batch plan plus a deterministic scope-safe worker queue and atomic claim-next will let many stateless workers self-schedule while preventing duplicate claims and concurrent overlap.

conditions.batch: control creates up to 100 durable WORK items from one plan
conditions.dispatch: only an independent set of scope-compatible ready work is visible
conditions.claim: workers atomically claim the first dispatchable WORK and retry after ref races
conditions.dependencies: dependent WORK stays blocked until predecessors are accepted
